Some of the warmest memories were never really about the mooncakes. 🌕 They were about the moments shared with the people who truly care.

🥮🎨Happy Dumpy’s Moonlit Reunion Design Collections bring those moments together — traditional and snow-skin mooncake sets, reimagined as Batu Seremban (five stones) in a variety of familiar mooncake flavours, inviting family and friends play together and strengthening meaningful bonds.
🧵 ✍️ And when the mooncake pouch is opened, the filling unfolds into a reusable bag - carrying those precious memories with us, wherever life takes us.

🌕月圆，不只是团圆于一桌。 更是团圆于记忆、情谊与人心。
和家人、朋友一起笑过的时光， 那些熟悉的味道、儿时的游戏， 以及多年以后，依然让我们想起彼此的温暖。
打开月饼袋，里头装着各种月饼口味的五粒子； 带回来的是一份永恒的回忆， 带走的是一份情，一份团圆。 🤍

#happydumpy #design #uniquegift #creative #midautumnfestival 

See y’ll at GMBB, First Floor GM1-17. Pick your favourite flavours and play together. Very limited pieces left. At Eslite too.
